service_name: Verification of QHP, APTC & CSR Enrollment
notes: Goal: Verify an applicant's enrollment status for QHP, APTC, and CSR.
request_elements: PersonBirthDate, PersonName, PersonSSNIdentification, InsuranceApplicantRequestedCoverage
response_elements: InsuranceApplicantQHPStatus, InsuranceApplicantAPTCStatus, InsuranceApplicantCSRStatus, InsurancePlan, ResponseCode, ResponseDescriptionText

service_name: Verify Annual Household Income and Family Size (IFSV)
notes: Goal: Bulk verification of annual household income and family size via IRS (Form 1040 data).
request_elements: PersonName, PersonSSNIdentification, TaxFilerCategoryCode
response_elements: TaxReturnYear, TaxReturnFilingStatusCode, TaxReturnAGIAmount, TaxReturnMAGIAmount, TaxReturnTaxableSocialSecurityBenefitsAmount, TaxReturnTotalExemptionsQuantity, ResponseCode

service_name: VeriSign Identity Protection (VIP) User Management
notes: Goal: Manage VIP users and their credentials, including creation, updates, and credential association/removal.
request_elements: UserID, UserEnabledIndicator, CredentialID, CredentialTypeCode, CredentialFriendlyNameText

service_name: Medicaid Eligibility Service Hub (MESH) Veterans Disability Rating Service JavaScript Object Notation
primary_purpose: Veterans Disability Rating Service - REST/JSON Interface
notes: Provides Permanent and Total Disability Rating (PTDR) and Summary Disability Rating (SDR). Supports both SSN and non-SSN request paths.
request_elements: personGivenName, personMiddleName, personSurName, personBirthDate, personSocialSecurityNumber, personSexCode, streetLineOneAddress, streetLineTwoAddress, cityName, stateText, zipCode, countryText, telephoneNumber
response_elements: permanentAndTotalStatusIndicator, totalDisabilityStatusIndicator, totalDisabilityEffectiveDate, combinedDisabilityRatingPercentage, combinedEffectiveDate, legalEffectiveDate, individualRatings (decisionText, ratingEffectiveDate, ratingEndDate, ratingPercentage, disabilityRatingId, staticIndicator)

response_schema.title: VA Disability Service (MH2) - Response Schema
response_schema.description: Response Schema for the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Disability Service.

ptdrInformation.description: Information relating to an individual's Permanent and Total Disability Rating (PTDR).

permanentAndTotalStatusIndicator.description: The PT status for service-connected disabilities.

totalDisabilityEffectiveDate.description: The date the service decision goes into effect. YYYY-MM-DD.

sdrInformation.description: Information relating to an individual's Summary Disability Rating (SDR).

combinedDisabilityRatingPercentage.description: The Veteran's combined disability rating percentage.

combinedEffectiveDate.description: Date the Veteran can start receiving disability benefits. YYYY-MM-DD.

legalEffectiveDate.description: Date of a law change that affects a Veteran's disability compensation. YYYY-MM-DD.

items.description: Information about each disability rating, which makes up the combined disability rating.

decisionText.description: Returns explanations of VA's decision on a claimant's disability or on their claim for a benefit.

ratingEffectiveDate.description: The date the service decision goes into effect. YYYY-MM-DD.

ratingEndDate.description: The date the service decision expires. YYYY-MM-DD.

ratingPercentage.description: The percentage of the assigned rating, based on the Veteran's disability.

disabilityRatingId.description: The individual disability rating identifier. Numeric only.

staticIndicator.description: The purpose of this field is to allow users to make a 'yes' or 'no' decision about re-examination for all disabilities that have not been determined to be static.

responseMetadataType.description: A set of details about a response (successful or not)

responseCode.description: A coded response: ME/MS/MX followed by 6 digits.

tdsResponseText.description: A description of a response from a data source designated as trusted (a trusted data source or TDS) by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services.

service_name: Annual Household Income and Family Size Verification (IFSV) REST JSON
notes: Goal: Verify annual household income and family size against IRS data to confirm eligibility for insurance affordability programs.
request_elements: applicantArray (taxFilerCategoryCode, personSurName, personGivenName, personSocialSecurityNumber, personMiddleName), requestID
response_elements: household (aggregateTaxReturnIncomeAmount, dependentVerificationArray (taxReturn (taxReturnYear, totalExemptionsQuantity, taxFilerSSN, taxReturnFilingStatusCode, taxableSocialSecurityBenefitsAmount, spouseSSN, adjustedTaxReturnIncomeAmount))), responseMetadata

service_name: Periodic Verification Composite (PVC) Service
notes: Goal: Batch periodic verification for Medicare and Death Master File (DMF) data.
request_elements: BatchID, BatchPartnerID, BatchAttachmentTotalQuantity, BatchCategoryCode, DocumentFileName, DocumentSequenceID, DocumentRecordCount
response_elements: ResponseMetadata, ResponseCode, ResponseDescriptionText, TDSResponseDescriptionText, DocumentFileName (in Response Manifest)

service_name: Advance Payment Computation (APC) Representational State Transfer (REST) JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) Service Business Service Definition (BSD)
notes: Goal: Calculate the Advance Premium Tax Credit (APTC) and Cost-Sharing Reductions (CSR) amounts based on household income and family size.
request_elements: householdIncomeAmount, taxYear, incomeFPLPercent, slcspMonthlyPremiumAmount

service_name: IRS Monthly Reporting Service
notes: API's goal is to report monthly health exchange enrollment and premium data (Form 1095-A equivalent) to the IRS. Responses include validation errors if the data does not conform to expected standards.
request_elements: SubmissionYr, SubmissionMonthNum, ApplicableCoverageYr, HealthExchangeId, IRSGroupIdentificationNum, TaxHouseholdCoverage, PrimaryFirstName, PrimaryLastName, SSN, BirthDt, USAddressGrp, Spouse, DependentPerson, QHPPolicyNum, QHPIssuerEIN, SLCSPAdjMonthlyPremiumAmt, HouseholdAPTCAmt, TotalHsldMonthlyPremiumAmt

response_schema.title: NSC (MH1) - Response Schema
response_schema.description: Response Schema for National Student Clearinghouse (NSC) Service.

oneOf.description: Business details of an NSC response.

transactionId.description: Unique ID generated by NSC identifying the transaction. 9-15 numeric characters.

orderId.description: Unique ID identifying an order. 9-15 numeric characters.

transactionStatusCode.description: Current status of the NSC transaction. Valid values: 'CNF' - Confirmed, 'UCF' - Unable to respond.

transactionFee.description: The fee per transaction, inclusive of school surcharges, if applicable. This will typically be 0.00.

salesTax.description: Any sales tax, as applicable. This will typically be 0.00.

transactionTotal.description: transactionFee and salesTax combined. This will typically be 0.00.

requestedByText.description: External systems account first name and last name.

requestedDateTimeText.description: Date and time of transaction request in format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.X' (e.g. '2018-05-01 10:13:28.0'). Does not include timezone.

notifiedDateTimeText.description: Date and time of transaction response in format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.X' (e.g. 2018-05-01 10:13:28.0'). Does not include timezone.

nscHitIndicator.description: Whether the student was successfully located in the NSC system. It is possible to receive a response of true without receiving data elements if the requested elements are not available. If nscHit = true, but no results are returned, possible reasons may be: 1. Enrollment records exist but degree records not located. 2. Student may have blocks or other impediments preventing access to their records. NSC will not reveal any further information. nscHitIndicator = false indicates that the student was not located in the NSC system.

studentInfoProvided.description: Student information as sent in the request.

previousNames.description: Previous names used by the individual. Up to 5 previous names may be included.

enrollmentDetails.description: Information relating the the school and the enrollment of the student.

officialSchoolName.description: Official name of school for which the student’s degree is confirmed.

schoolCode.description: The six-digit School ID assigned by the Department of Education for the requested school.

branchCode.description: Two-digit identifier of a branch within a school. See Appendix for details.

currentEnrollmentStatusCode.description: The current enrollment status of the student. Valid values include: 'CC' - Currently Enrolled, 'CN' - Currently not Enrolled.

enrollmentData.description: Information relating the the school enrollment of the student.

enrollmentStatusCode.description: Enrollment status of the student (if released by the school; if not, then ‘Y’). Valid values include: 'F' - Full-time, 'Q' - Three-quarter time, 'H' - Half-time, 'L' - Less than half-time, 'Y' - Enrollment Status Not Released by School, 'A' - Leave of Absence, 'W' - Withdrawn, 'S' - Clearinghouse Generated Withdrawn, 'G' - Graduated, 'D' - Deceased. NOTE: This information is returned to the requestor based on whether the school from which the information is requested agrees to release it. This information may NOT be received as response data on all VS requests.

termBeginDate.description: Start-date of the school’s enrollment term.

termEndDate.description: End-date of the school’s enrollment term.

schoolCertifiedOnDate.description: Date the school certified the enrollment record.

anticipatedGraduationDate.description: The student's anticipated graduation date provided by the school, based on school enrollment data.

responseMetadataType.description: A set of details about a response (successful or not)

responseCode.description: A coded response: ME/MS/MX followed by 6 digits.

tdsResponseText.description: A description of a response from a data source designated as trusted (a trusted data source or TDS) by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services.
